messages:
Front Desk: Quick heads up — we have an unexpected visitor arriving ~6:45pm. Badge printer is out of mag stripe stock; can someone pick up a temporary paper badge or escort? They'll be meeting in 7th-floor lounge.
Emma: I can grab a printable sticker from the supply closet and bring it down. ETA 10m.
Nick: If you need someone to escort, I can stay till 7:30. Who is it?
Front Desk: Name: Dr. Riley Park (Acme Health). Meeting with @Marcus. Thanks @Emma! Also one courier just dropped 3 small boxes for Marcus in lobby locker 3.
Marcus: On my way out now, should be there by 6:40. Can someone leave a Post-it with 'Marcus - 7F lounge' on the package? Also — can the visitor use Meeting Room B? It's booked but I can swap with 6:30 slot.
Aditi: I swapped Meeting Room B with the 6:30 team — visitor ok to use it. @Front Desk please put '7F Lounge' on badge if they prefer open lounge.
Front Desk: Sticker printed and guest checked in with temporary badge. Left a Post-it on locker 3. Quick policy note: we've had a courier ask us to accept food deliveries for visitors — please don't assume acceptance; courier will only leave with a signature. If you want a delivery accepted, reply here with 'OK to accept'.
Emma: Noted. I won't sign for food unless asked.
Marcus: OK to accept for me (lunch). Thanks for the heads up.
DeliveryBot: Package logged: 3 items for Marcus -> Lobby locker 3. Tracking: TRK12345, TRK12346, TRK12347. Signed by Front Desk at 18:35.
Front Desk: All good — guest escorted up by Nick, meeting room prepped, and packages labeled. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Emma: Thanks! :wave:
Nick: No prob, glad I could help.
thread_summary: visitor arrives late; badge printer low on mag stripe, temporary sticker used; packages for Marcus in locker 3; discussion about accepting food deliveries for visitors and who can sign for them.
